stageFiledHint: Submitted in MOS, have or await the UPO
stageDecisionHint: Positive, negative or a card to collect
orgEmployerPlaceholder: Company name as on your contract
fullNameError: Enter the name I should use for you.
welcomeSub: Let me tell you what I found. It takes a minute.
helloSub: Tell me who you are and what’s going on. Just talk.
nameSub: I’m Dossierly, your caseworker for life in Poland.
languageSub: I’ll write and call you in it.
reasonSub: It decides which residence rules apply to you.
stageSub: I’ll start from where you are.
citySub: It tells me which office handles your case.
detailsSub: And when you arrived, if you know.
phoneTitle: Can I call you when it’s urgent?
phoneSub: Like a summons with a 14-day deadline.
inboxCalendarTitle: Add these dates to your calendar
inboxCalendarSub: You’ll get a reminder before each one.
inboxSavedSub: Everything you ticked is in your case now.
inboxReviewSub: Untick anything that’s wrong. Only ticked items are saved.
inboxReadingSub: Muse Spark reads each official email and notes where every fact came from.
inboxEmptySub: I’ll read new letters when they arrive.
inboxConnectSub: Read-only. I look for letters from the office, MOS and your university.
ownWordsPlaceholder: I’m Arjun, I study in Warsaw, and I got a letter from the office.
gmailWhat: Finds letters from the office, MOS and your university
allSetBody: Your case, next step and dates are waiting. Talk to me any time from the call button.
intakeError: That didn’t go through. Try again.
intakeMissed: I didn’t catch that. Tap the microphone and try again, or type instead.
furtherAlong: Your emails show you’re further along.
setStageAsk: Should I set your stage to “{stage}”?
savedOne: 1 item, linked to the email it came from.
savedMany: {n} items, each linked to the email it came from.
docMissingValue: The office asked for it. It isn’t in your email.
noOfficialEmails: No official emails in {account} from the last 120 days.
addPhotoLook: You can add a photo of a letter any time in Look.
noneRelevant: None of these are about your residence case.
keepEye: I’ll keep an eye out for new official mail.
remindersSet: Reminders are set for the day before and a few days ahead of each deadline.
callsOn: Calls are on for this number.
callsOnBody: If an urgent letter arrives, I’ll phone you and explain it. You can switch calls off any time.
callsSoonBody: Phone-call alerts are coming soon. Until then I’ll alert you in the app, and your number stays unverified and unused.
alreadyVerified: Already verified for calls on this account
countryCodeHint: With country code. A Polish or home number works.
skipPhone: Skip, alerts in the app only
gcalWhat: Adds the dates you confirm, with reminders
connectionFailed: That connection didn’t finish, so nothing was shared. You can try again, or skip this step.
outlookAppleNote: Apple Calendar: every deadline has an .ics download. Outlook mail reading is coming soon.
purposeGmail: Find relevant messages and review attachments before importing.
purposeOutlook: Find relevant mail and explicitly choose what to import.
purposeGcal: Add a reviewed date to the calendar you choose.
purposeMscal: Add reviewed dates to your Microsoft / Outlook calendar.
badConnectionUrl: The connection URL was not valid. Please retry.
disconnectedRevoke: Disconnected from Dossierly. Review or remove this app’s permissions separately in your provider account.
connectionsIntro: Choose up to one mail provider and one calendar. Connections are optional. Mail content is imported only after you review and accept it.
cleanupNotice: Your current connection is usable, but removing the previous provider connection still needs attention.
notAvailable: This connection is not available yet.
composioNote: Connection data passes through Composio and your provider under their privacy and retention policies. Imported copies stay in your encrypted browser vault.
mailApproval: You will be asked to approve read-only mail access. Review the provider’s permission screen. Dossierly does not send email.
calendarApproval: You will be asked to approve calendar access. Adding an event remains a separate, explicit action.
replacesMail: This replaces your current mail provider after approval.
replacesCalendar: This replaces your current calendar provider after approval.
appleBody: Download a reviewed all-day .ics file and choose whether to add it yourself. No Apple sign-in or two-way sync.
needDate: A reviewed, calculated date is needed before downloading a calendar file.
addEventTitle: Add a date to your connected calendar
allDayEvent: All-day event · {date}. No invitations or attendees.
sampleDateNote: This is a fictional sample date. Save it only if you want a clearly labelled SAMPLE event in your real calendar.
eventAdded: The reviewed all-day event was added to your selected calendar.
noCalendars: No calendars are available for this connection.
legacyLead: Your case lives on this device, encrypted. Your agent works from a masked copy so it can remember.
legacySample: Temporary residence and work · Mazowiecki office, Warsaw · fingerprints taken on 18 Sep, a letter is on its way.
legacyScope: Poland only for now: temporary residence and work in the Mazowieckie voivodeship. Germany and France are next.
requestUnfinished: That request could not finish. Your draft has been kept.
readingUnavailable: Reading is temporarily unavailable. Please try again shortly.
draftInterrupted: The previous request was interrupted. Your pages and answers are safe; retry when ready.
reviewProfileFirst: Review your profile and selected priorities first.
reviewDocumentFirst: Review your own document and profile before saving.
reviewPriorities: Review or explicitly skip every selected priority.
